highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148, and rolls up the 4.147.x previews.
highlights_body: It adds variable fonts, color font palettes and animated WebP encoding, reworks the singleton lifecycle, and refreshes native dependencies. This is a breaking release for typeface null-handling and Vulkan Ganesh setup — check the changes below before upgrading.

breaking.title: SKFont and SKPaint no longer resolve a lazy default typeface
breaking.body: `new SKFont().Typeface` is now `SKTypeface.Empty` instead of `null`, so `MeasureText` returns 0 until you set a typeface; construct with `new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default)` and check `Typeface.IsEmpty` instead of `== null`. `new SKPaint().Typeface` now returns `SKTypeface.Default` instead of `null`, but text still draws out of the box.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName and SKTypeface.Default are now never null
breaking.body: `FromFamilyName("missing")` returns `SKTypeface.Default` on every platform (previously `null` on Android), and `SKTypeface.Default` is guaranteed non-null everywhere. For a strict "was it found?" check, use `SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name, style)`, which still returns null on no match.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws on overflow and is obsolete
breaking.body: The native offset is a 32-bit int; out-of-range values now throw `OverflowException` instead of silently truncating, and the overload carries an [Obsolete] (CS0618) warning. Call `Move(int)` with a validated, in-range offset instead.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0 instead of returning null
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1; a 1.0 instance or device makes Skia call SK_ABORT and terminate the process rather than let CreateVulkan fail gracefully. Declare `VK_API_VERSION_1_1` on both the `VkApplicationInfo.apiVersion` and `GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion` (do not leave MaxAPIVersion at its default 0). Genuinely 1.0-only hardware can no longer run Ganesh Vulkan.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative dropped five interop fields
breaking.body: `fMinAPIVersion`, `fInstanceVersion`, `fExtensions`, `fFeatures`, and `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice` were removed. Delete those assignments; use `fVkExtensions` in place of `fExtensions` and `fDeviceFeatures`/`fDeviceFeatures2` in place of `fFeatures`. There is no replacement for `fOwnsInstanceAndDevice`.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retyped, and GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost value-equality
breaking.body: The property is now `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo` (was `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo`), which gained a new `Components` field and no longer implements `IEquatable<T>` or the `==`/`!=` operators. Update manual struct construction for the new field, and replace equality checks with member comparisons.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose lost its public setter
breaking.body: The protected `IgnorePublicDispose` property is now get-only. Code that set it directly must move that logic into the constructor or a dedicated method.

bullets.lead: Skia updated through milestones 132, 133, and 147 to m148
bullets.detail: Bundles the v4 Skia engine jump from m119 to m148, rolling up several rounds of upstream chrome/m147 bug fixes along the way.

bullets.lead: Variable fonts and color font palettes
bullets.detail: Adds variable font support to SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, and adds color font palette support alongside general variable-font robustness improvements.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream access
bullets.detail: SKWebpEncoder can now encode animated WebP images, and the new SKStream.GetData() gives zero-copy access to stream contents as SKData.

bullets.lead: SKSamplingOptions support and new HarfBuzzSharp APIs
bullets.detail: SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface gain SKSamplingOptions overloads, and HarfBuzzSharp adds the HBColor struct plus several missing API wrappers with corrected naming.

bullets.lead: Legacy paint/text obsoletes promoted to compiler errors
bullets.detail: The pre-v4 obsolete SKPaint text/font members and remaining legacy paint state-reading APIs are now compile errors rather than warnings, completing the v3→v4 migration path.

bullets.lead: Fixed pixel-span offset and stride bugs
bullets.detail: SKPixmap.GetPixelSpan<T>(x, y) used Height instead of Width when computing the offset, and both SKPixmap and SKBitmap GetPixelSpan used the wrong value for stride; both now use RowBytes correctly.

bullets.lead: Fixed a SKPath finalizer crash and MAUI rendering glitch
bullets.detail: SKPath no longer crashes in its finalizer when the backing SKPathBuilder is collected first, and SKGLView now redraws correctly after a MAUI TabBar tab switch.

bullets.lead: Fixed WinUI Projection DLL resolution for .NET 9
bullets.detail: Consumers targeting .NET 9 no longer hit a missing WinUI Projection DLL at runtime.

Reworks how SkiaSharp's internal singleton instances are initialized and disposed, and moves the native-compatibility gate from a [ModuleInitializer] to the SkiaApi static constructor for more predictable startup ordering.

bullets.lead: Expanded native asset and target framework support
bullets.detail: Adds Linux Bionic native assets, x64/arm64 Tizen native builds, PolySharp support for C# 13 on legacy TFMs, and splits Apple TFMs into unversioned app / 26.0 library targets; WASM drops native builds for pre-.NET 8 Emscripten versions.
Updates libpng, libexpat/expat, zlib, freetype, libjpeg-turbo, and HarfBuzz to their latest patched versions.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Variable font support, the singleton lifecycle rework, the SKPath finalizer fix, and the Skia m132/m147 milestone bumps.
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets support and PolySharp for C# 13 on legacy TFMs.
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Reduced the SkiaFiddle WASM sample application size by around 60%.
contributor_summaries.sasakrsmanovic: Updated the Uno Platform link and description in the README.
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fixed SKGLView not rendering after a MAUI TabBar tab switch.

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line with the Skia m132/m133 bumps, variable font support, and the initial obsolete-API promotions.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, the SKPath finalizer fix, and the Apple TFM split.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 bumped Skia to m147, added HarfBuzzSharp API wrappers and HBColor, and refreshed native dependencies including libpng, zlib, and freetype.
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Release Candidate 1 bumped Skia to m148, reworked the singleton lifecycle, promoted the remaining legacy paint APIs to compile errors, and fixed the pixel-span stride bugs ahead of stable.

harfbuzz_summary: Bundles HarfBuzz 14.2.0 with variable font shaping support, the new HBColor value type, and several corrected API wrapper names.
